memory_candidates.content: When wiring a new core context/patterns/*.md anchor into a dispatch-file echo block (e.g. orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's unconditional Wait Discipline section), a source-store-relative filesystem path is WRONG for cross-extension prose pointers -- extensions merge flatly into a shared deployed context/ tree, so the correct citation form is the deploy-relative path (e.g. `context/patterns/foo.md`), matching the convention already used throughout the source store (e.g. `context/patterns/dispatch-report-not-termination.md` cited from unrelated extension agent files). Only links between files that stay within the SAME extension's own context tree (e.g. core patterns/ to core contracts/) can safely use a literal source-store-relative path, since source-store and deployed layout coincide there.

check-task-references.sh and check-extension-docs.sh both refuse to run directly from the agent-system source store scripts/ directory (a deploy-root-guard fires) and must instead be invoked via the deployed copy at .claude/scripts/<name>.sh, or with an explicit REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) override for check-extension-docs.sh's source-store mode. A source-store-only edit (never redeployed) will show up as expected 'deployed script content drift' in check-extension-docs.sh's core extension report -- this is not a content defect, just deploy staleness inherent to the source-store/deploy boundary.
